chunks: "When you travel, prepare provisions for the journey and make them pleasant."

key_terms.إِذَا: when; introducing the circumstance of travel
key_terms.سَافَرْتُمْ: you travel; setting the context of being on a journey
key_terms.سُفْرَةً: travel provisions or a food spread prepared for the journey
key_terms.فَاتَّخِذُوا: then take or prepare; an instruction to make arrangements
key_terms.فِيهَا: in it; referring to the provisions or travel spread
key_terms.وَتَنَوَّقُوا: make it pleasant or select it carefully

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about preparing provisions for travel?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper etiquette for travel by encouraging travelers to take provisions with them and to prepare them well. It reflects an Islamic emphasis on orderly conduct, good preparation, and maintaining comfort and refinement even while traveling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2450 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When you travel, prepare provisions for the journey and make them pleasant."
